rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs approved by ACPE (or an equivalent accrediting body determined by the board); up to 6 hours of pharmacy-related ACCME-approved CE; non-ACPE residency hours not accepted
rules.new_licensee_rule: The first renewal may be granted without CE if the license was obtained within one year after completing pharmaceutical education; otherwise CE starts immediately upon licensure.
rules.alternatives: Hardship exception or a six-month compliance extension on written request to the board; military exemption.
rules.audit_note: Compliance audits after each license period (statute: up to 5% of Colorado-resident pharmacists annually). Keep certificates at least 4 years; send only if requested.
rules.notes: No mandatory topics stated. Evidence is a sign-off box on the renewal application. Missing the 24 hours makes the license inactive.
